_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and 6/6 hold record plus non-printing froth/unwind breakers keep the score inside Hope; HOLD is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Hope and non-action; analyst explicitly forwards HOLD, narrative implies measured wait
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-70, funding near flat, 30d momentum sub-parabolic so score stays in Hope band
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum+funding both lift hard toward 2019 mini-top zone (rung up to Optimism) or crowded-long/skew unwind with F&G under ~55 (rung down to Disbelief)
